newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline loses some ground, market balanced.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline loses some ground, market balanced.

text.p: NWE gasoline lost a few dollars in thin trade on Monday but players said the downside was limited in a balanced market.

"This market is balanced to a bit short. There is concealed demand in the Med and Europe and it is significant that nothing is going into storage as it normally does at this time of year," one refiner said.

Trade was limited to a couple of barge deals -- a prompt eurograde parcel at $224 a tonne fob ARA and an unleaded regular barge at $221 fob ARA. Both were bought by the same Wall Street refiner. A January swap traded at $214 a tonne.
